bias.en: Bearish, improving · back above the 200-day, SAR bullish
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · 重回 200 日均线上方，SAR 转多

read.en: Arm rose 4.1% on Oct 28 to $235.90, trading between $228.10 and $237.00. It is above the rising 200-day ($227.8) and the falling 5-day ($221.3) and 10-day ($225.5) averages, and below the falling 30-day ($268.6) and 100-day ($283.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 28 ($208.30), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: Arm 10月28日上涨 4.1%，收于 $235.90，盘中区间 $228.10–237.00。股价位于上行的 200 日均线（$227.8）以及下行的 5 日（$221.3）和 10 日均线（$225.5）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$268.6）和 100 日均线（$283.6）。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 10月28日转为看多（$208.30），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The close cleared the 200-day and $229 (Oct 21 high), now support, and turned the SAR bullish; the $237 high stopped under $238–239.4. Resistance is $238–239.4 (Sep 14 low, Oct 16 high), then $243.1–245.9 (Jul 17 low, Oct 15 high) and $250.2 (Oct 14 high). Support is $227.8–229, then $225.5 (10-day) and $221.3 (5-day). A close above $239.4 would target $245–250; below $227.8, $221–225.

s.en: 200-day average $227.8; Oct 21 high $229.0, now support; Oct 28 low $228.1
